reviewer: Project review after the browser verdict, written with Claude Code (the AI assistant that built this project). A reading of the patch, not another test.
verdict: Removes the trap by changing when the calendar opens
summary: Inputs no longer open the calendar on focus; a click opens it instead, so tabbing through the field never enters vanilla-calendar-pro’s key handling.
caveats: Opening on focus was the designed behaviour for input datepickers; keyboard users now open the calendar another way (click, or the page’s own control).
The underlying Tab handling inside the open calendar is unchanged; twbs/bootstrap#43202 is still open and this patch is not proposed there.
